notes.title: DHXP 2025 Anniversary event
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you for sticking with us all these years![/h1]

It's been over a decade since we began this journey, as this month marks [i]eleven[/i] years of Digital Happiness' first-ever launched title, DreadOut. What started as a small spark has grown into a world of stories and shared memories with you, our beloved players.

Everything we've built was made with passion, sleepless nights, and LOTS of coffee. And through it all, you've been there playing, supporting, and believing in us.

DHXP is the pulse of everything we’ve created so far. And to this day, it has always been more than a celebration, it’s a thank you, a look back, and a vision of what lies ahead.

And for you, thank you for being part of this journey. Whether you’ve been here since the beginning, or you just stumbled into our world someway somehow, we're glad you're here.

[h2]Then what lies beyond the 11th year?[/h2]

This is the fun part. Currently, there are so many things going on in our headquarters, and we're so excited to share them with you. We're working on titles that you might have expected and not expected!

[previewyoutube=uYlkB3py6EE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Also check out the DHXP 2025 Steam Sale Page by clicking the banner below:[/h3]

[url=bit.ly/dhxp2025][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371531/f6f256432d7ba3a4c98fa44749cb058a7bd9463e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Did someone mention sale?[/h2]
Of course, we have a special sale going on too! Take a look around and dive into the games that have shaped us as a developers. You can get it with [b]up to 80% off[/b]!

Please spread the news because this offer lasts through May 24, 2025!

Hope you enjoy every bit of it!

:DH

notes.title: DreadHaunt Update 2023-12-20
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33371531/07d380d2395eacdd707e403d3e5806bfd69af98a.png[/img]
Good day, Agents.

We have updated DreadHaunt to version 20231218, and these are notable details that the HQ want to share:

[h2]Post-Session Results Screen[/h2]

After each session, you’ll be presented with an eye-catching post-result screen. Showing who’s the possessed one, who survived (or didn’t), and how many points you racked up during the mission. 

[h2](Ongoing) Audio Updates[/h2]

We decided to overhaul the Audio System including BGM & SFX assets. You will notice a few changes during gameplay

[h2](Ongoing) Controller Support[/h2]

Controller support is available in very early stage. If you the controller-wielding type of agent, we are looking forward to hear your experiences!

[h2]Bug Fixes, Here and There[/h2]

- Added subtitle size option to Settings.
- Spectro damage effect +15%
- Kunti attack charge 25 -> 28.75
- Asih attack charge 10 -> 11.5
- Prevent drop tools while opening voter
- BugFix: Kunti attack charge hit multiple times
- Add condition to disable host quit button when in game
- add descriptions to sprectro skills
- fix mouse cursor not reappearing during waiting for players

[h2]Known Bugs/Glitches[/h2]

- BGM not playing on Versus Mode
- etc.

[h2]Sneak Peek of Future Contents[/h2]

We have a Content Update Plans on the DreadHaunt store page, check it out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1855580/DreadHaunt/

Last but not least, if you have any suggestions or experienced bugs or glitches about the game, Feel free to reach us out on Steam Community Forum and our official discord server at discord.gg/dreaduniverse

notes.title: DreadHaunt Demo available now
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thanks for checking out our DreadHaunt Demo.
DreadHaunt is our first foray into the online horror multiplayer genre, we are very thrilled to hear what you guys think of our current alpha build Demo. The Demo itself will only available from today until June 20th. The feedback from all of you will be considered and implemented in the final product. 

DreadHaunt [b]will not be[/b] released as free to play games, but instead will be a fully released game with decent enough content to keep us all busy :)

As the development is still in progress, we will continue to improve the final product based on input and suggestions from the community along the way.

After the final product is released, and If the community responds well, we are committed to releasing more content with more game modes, levels, and characters under future DLCs or seasonal passes.

Please consider joining our community for more information and updates.
Appreciate for all of your support.

Much love,
Digital Happiness

notes.title: Dread Universe 6 Years Anniversary
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
During these exceptional times, we would like to say our proper thanks to all of your support.
6 years ago, DreadOut was born from a mere dream. Started from this piece of paper :) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33639908/57aadce1622db938dc932bad6de0e1e1ca1c1f1b.jpg[/img]

And with all of your support, we can continue making something that we loved for, making video games. With the growing and more diverse content being widely received by gamers, we hope that our game is able to show a small glimpse of our culture in a unique way, which was being rarely presented in video games. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33639908/5e4668ec164b780a2baf6de420ed9bf15b8f3cad.jpg[/img]

Along these years, we are still continuing to learn how to make proper video games that can capture the hearts and minds of players all around the world. That being said it was easier said than done, and we are hoping we can both grow together in the next decade or more. Stay tuned for any future releases and upcoming updates from us! :)

[previewyoutube=3UnZeE2PSxA;full][/previewyoutube]

All the best, 
Digital Happiness

notes.title: DreadOut Movie Trailer released
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5991913/e1522d4933acda259644ddd51f8ee9c2cc413c87.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,
As you might already known, Indonesia isn’t famous for producing a video game titles, even less being adapted into a live action movie.
So, today we would like to inform you, our first foray into video games movie adaptation based from our game DreadOut, will be release in Indonesia’s cinema on January 2019. As for worldwide distribution would be announced later after our release on locals cinema nationwide. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5991913/495ac491fca68abf0c1c3cbe8f09acf49ab1e292.jpg[/img]
  
Without further ado here is our Trailer of DreadOut Movie and press release regarding DreadOut Movie as well;
[url=]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N9ymyIhAUV0[/url]
[b]About:[/b]
DreadOut Movie is the first live action adaptation based from Indonesian survival horror game DreadOut developed by Digital Happiness, an indie game developer from Bandung, West Java, Indonesia. An international collaboration project between Indonesia, Korea, and Japan.

Even without being labelled as direct adaptation from the game, DreadOut movie will still maintaining the basic concept of survival horror in original DreadOut game and further deepen the lores behind Dread universe, also set as prequel of the main story in DreadOut game as well.

DreadOut movie is produced under goodhouse id production company. Directed by Kimo Stamboel from the producer of recent Netflix’s [b]The Night comes for us (2018)[/b], and famously directed [b]Headshot (2016), Killers (2014)[/b]  and [b]Macabre (2013[/b]) as [url=https://www.imdb.com/name/nm3125415/]The Mo brothers[/url]. notes.title: Indonesian National Game Day
notes.content:
[img=]http://dreadout.com/images/hargai.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone, 
On August 8th 2016 Indonesian game industries will establish Hari Game Indonesia (HARGAI) or National Game Day. 
 
Indonesian National game day or Hari game Indonesia (HARGAI) was government initiated and supported by various game developers, publishers, payment solutions, board games and media in Indonesia as a form of appreciation to local game developers, publishers, and also gamers to create a better game ecosystem in our country. 
 
And to celebrate the day, we are happy to announce that 
DreadOut is now sale 80% off on Steam, and DreadOut: Keepers of The Dark is 33% off. 
 
Happy Game Day!! Enjoy Our Special Sale! 
#HARGAI #HariGameIndonesia
[url=]https://www.harigameindonesia.com[/url]

DH

notes.title: DreadOut: Keepers of the Dark release
notes.content:
[img=]http://www.dreadout.com/do/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/KOTD-release-24-3-16.jpg[/img]
Hello guys,
This  time we are happy to announce that DreadOut : Keepers of the Dark / KOTD  is available now. In this standalone extension of DreadOut game.
[url=]http://store.steampowered.com/app/269790/[/url]

You will continue as Linda's last journey before the event battle with The mysterious lady in red. 

As many of you might not know that DreadOut is first came from an Indiegogo crowdfunding campaign on 2013, got greenlit by Steam Greenlight after we put it for 6 months for 60K yes vote by you guys, finally we are able to release our first act and continue on our second act, and now we are close to our final take on the game, DreadOut : Keepers of The Dark.

you can check our websites for further information about DreadOut
[url=]http//www.dreadout.com[/url]

Hope you’re enjoyed playing DreadOut : KOTD as much as we did enjoyed making it.
